report:
Reviewed the complete claim and all three test entries against the sole implementation entry, which is explicitly TODO. This is acceptance of an honest deferral, not approval of completed elaboration.
Requirements: (1) completed bodies consume method syntax and temporary adjustment recipes; (2) implicit borrow, dereference, and coercion operations become explicit typed nodes; (3) successful output contains no unresolved source-shaped placeholder anywhere; (4) control flow stays a structured tree, without basic blocks, drop scheduling, generator lowering, or borrow-check results.
The implementation TODO and todo::types_body_elaborated both explicitly identify retained source-shaped TyExprData variants and require completion plus whole-tree rejection tests. Captured tytree/mod.rs corroborates that prerequisite: MethodCall, IfLet, WhileLet, For, Await, Try, Closure, Index, MacroCall, Unresolved and Missing remain representable alongside Ref, Deref, NeverToAny and ResolvedCall. Captured finalize.rs copy_expr_data preserves several source-shaped variants rather than providing a universal rejection invariant. This is the gap already declared by the TODO, not a newly discovered claim of successful universal elaboration. Before that TODO can be removed, all supported operation families must elaborate, unsupported cases must be diagnosed, and a whole-tree successful-output validator/test matrix must reject retained unresolved operations and temporary recipes. No claim of universal coercion coverage is made.
The ordinary clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call test supplies substantive partial evidence. It constructs a derived Clone receiver case; checks zero diagnostics; matches Block -> ResolvedCall; verifies clone and Clone identity/static dispatch and ADT Self; requires exactly one receiver; matches an explicit shared Ref with a typed dummy lifetime, resolved Field with owner DbDropGuard and expected type, explicit Deref, and Local path. Thus leaving source method syntax or omitting borrow/dereference would fail visible assertions. Captured BuiltinDeriveTcx provides the Clone trait/member and shared-reference receiver signature; database setup invokes the callback on the parsed fixture.
The ordinary comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows test covers equal and less on u32 from the captured fixture. In both cold and warm callbacks it requires no body diagnostics, a block tail resolved call, correct eq/lt and PartialEq/PartialOrd names and static trait dispatch, bool result, exactly two operands, and explicit shared Ref nodes with Ref types using Lifetime::Dummy. The outer empty diagnostics value alone is not the semantic assertion: the substantive assertions are inside the callback, which the captured helper executes twice. Captured combined.rs supplies a live metadata-backed database and fixture text. These two tests are narrow examples, not a whole-tree elaboration proof.
The TODO test has no assertions and establishes no behavior. Its prerequisite is substantive completion and whole-tree rejection testing, including coercions and unsupported constructs, as its comment states. It remains visibly deferred. Structural control-flow boundaries are consistent with TyBodyData's root/locals/span and nested TyExprData If/Match/Loop/While children; no basic-block graph, drop schedule, lowered generator, or borrow-check result fields occur in the captured body representation. The associated examples assert block/tree shapes but do not exhaustively exercise those boundaries; exhaustive whole-tree tests remain within the declared TODO.
All implementation and test entries are accounted for; there are no N/A entries. Additional captured source is used to justify the existing deferral and interpret partial tests, not to promote unassociated production code to a completed implementation. This was a source review: I ran cargo meta review start/read and record only, with rg for navigation; I did not execute behavior tests or claim they passed. No source files changed and no additional behavioral obligation outside the existing implementation TODO was identified.
